lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a non-uniform grid-like pattern posterior to the branchial region, with higher spatial density observed toward the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the larger high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a distinct shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark horizontal linear mark, appearing as a deep scar or laceration, is visible on the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A significant transition in spot diameter is visible, with smaller, higher-density spots on the rostrum/head region and larger, more widely spaced spots on the lateral flank.
